name: cursor-pager-footer
title: Cursor pager footer
description: Responsive stateless cursor-pagination footer for data-table paginated={false}. Forwards CursorPaginationProps: hasPrevious, hasNext, onPrevious, onNext, loading, busy, summary, shownCount, total, unavailableBehaviour, pageSize, pageSizeOptions, onPageSizeChange, previousLabel, nextLabel, ariaLabel, loadingLabel, labels and className. Consumer-owned opaque cursors stay outside the kit. summary accepts plain text or null; the count form requires labels.shownSummary and labels.totalSummary; select options require labels.rowsPerPage and labels.rowsPerPageLabel. Flat names override labels.previous, labels.next and labels.navLabel, then catalog defaults. loadingLabel=null preserves the summary while busy. One persistent polite atomic status; buttons remain focusable when aria-disabled. Removal of a focused control moves focus to Next, Previous, select, then nav root, including while busy. No page numbers or ranges. No props renders fixtures.
